posts.title: Welcome to the Studio Journal
posts.summary: A place for teaching notes, practice ideas, chamber music reflections, and news from the studio.
posts.body:
Music learning is a long, individual journey. This journal will share ideas that support students and families along the way—from establishing a joyful practice routine to discovering the listening skills that make chamber music meaningful.

Check back here for teaching notes, studio announcements, and upcoming activities.

posts.summary: Practical ideas for young cellists, families, and developing musicians will be shared here.
